connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Where Orqen can reach your Jira, GitLab, Confluence and Figma.
connections.empty: No connections yet. A connection tells Orqen where a provider lives and how to authenticate; add one, then run a test to see whether it is reachable.

form.description: Base URL, port and path are kept exactly as you enter them.
form.name: Name
form.allowedHostsHint: Comma separated. Defaults to the base URL host.
form.nameHint: Choose an internal label, such as “Engineering Jira”. It does not need to match your account or site name.
form.providerHint: Choose the service you want to connect. Jira supplies issues, GitLab supplies code, Confluence holds documentation, and Figma holds designs.
form.baseUrlHint: Copy the service root from your browser or ask your administrator. Keep any port and installation path (for example /jira); omit project, issue and login paths. Never put a token in this URL.
form.usernameHint: For Jira Cloud, enter the email of the Atlassian account that created the API token. For Jira Server / Data Center Basic authentication, use your local account username.
form.timeoutHint: 1,000–120,000 ms; default 15,000 (15 seconds). Increase for a slow network; a longer timeout also delays reporting an unreachable service.
form.concurrencyHint: 1–32 requests at once; default 4. Higher values can speed up work but increase server load and rate-limit errors. Lower this if the service returns 429.
form.hostsHint: Comma-separated hostnames, without a scheme or path. If empty, only the base URL host is allowed. Ask your administrator for redirect destinations; adding hosts broadens where redirects may go.
form.proxyHint: Optional. Ask your network administrator for an http://, https:// or socks5:// proxy address, including its port. Useful for restricted networks; adds a network hop. URLs containing a username or password are not accepted. Leave empty for a direct connection.
form.caHint: Optional. Ask your IT team for the trusted CA certificate in PEM format (BEGIN CERTIFICATE), for example for an internal certificate authority. This adds trust for private TLS certificates; do not paste a private key. Leave empty to use system trust.
form.nextStep: After saving, open “Credential” for this connection to enter the token or password, then run “Test connection”. Creating the connection alone does not grant access.

guide.title: Guide for your selection
guide.unsupportedProvider: This version can save this provider’s settings and test connectivity, but its authentication, identity, capabilities and sample access checks are not implemented yet.
guide.unsupportedAuth: This authentication method is not supported by Orqen for the selected provider and deployment. Choose a compatible method before testing.
guide.atlassianCloud: In your Atlassian account, open Security → API tokens → Create API token. Use it with the account email. A token with scopes may require an api.atlassian.com gateway URL; follow the official URL instructions and verify compatibility with Test connection.
guide.atlassianPat: In Jira, open your avatar → Profile → Personal Access Tokens → Create token. In Confluence, open your avatar → Settings → Personal Access Tokens. If the option is missing, ask your administrator whether your version and policy allow it.
guide.gitlab: In GitLab, open your avatar → Edit profile → Access → Personal access tokens. Choose a name, expiry and scopes. For read-only API access, start with read_api; available data still depends on your project role. Copy the token when created.
guide.figma: In Figma, open Settings → Security → Personal access tokens → Generate new token. Choose expiry and the scopes needed for the endpoints you will use. Access remains limited to files available to that account.
guide.basicSource: Use the local service username and password supplied by your administrator. For Jira Cloud, use your Atlassian email and an API token instead of your account password.
guide.oauthSource: Obtain an access token through an OAuth application registered with the provider, with help from its administrator or developer. This form accepts an existing token later in Credential; it does not start an authorization flow or automatically refresh tokens.
guide.api_token: API tokens can be revoked without changing your password. For Jira Cloud they require the account email. For GitLab this option sends the token like a personal access token; for Jira Server / Data Center it sends a Bearer token. Expiry, permissions and server policy still apply.
guide.personal_access_token: Personal access tokens avoid sharing your password and can be revoked independently. They inherit account access, further limited by any scopes. They need replacement after expiry or revocation. Jira Cloud uses API token instead.
guide.basic: Basic authentication is simple but requires sending the username and secret on every request; use HTTPS. Local passwords may be blocked by SSO or server policy. Jira Cloud uses an API token as the secret. Orqen does not support Basic for GitLab.
guide.oauth: OAuth provides delegated, scoped access without sharing an account password, but requires an application and user authorization. Orqen sends an existing access token as Bearer; renewing expired tokens is currently manual.
guide.cloud: Cloud: hosted by the service provider, such as gitlab.com or your-team.atlassian.net. No server to maintain; access and rate limits depend on the provider, plan and organization policy. Figma is offered as a cloud service.
guide.server: Server: an installation run by your organization. Get the address and version from your administrator; VPN or a custom CA may be required. You control the network, but supported APIs and token types depend on the installed version.
guide.data_center: Data Center: Atlassian’s organization-hosted deployment for Jira / Confluence. It offers infrastructure control and clustering, with license and maintenance costs. Ask the administrator for the base URL and allowed authentication methods.
guide.self_managed: Self-managed: your organization runs the service, commonly GitLab. It gives control over data and network settings, but your team maintains it. Ask for its base URL, VPN requirements and token policy. For Figma choose Cloud.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Connect GitLab and Jira, store a credential and run the connection test until both are verified.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Pick repositories, map each to Jira, check the mapping, review the repository contract and approve a test command.

profile.title: Model profile
profile.description: Create or import a profile, validate and publish it, then bind it to your projects.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: Choose how much Orqen may do on its own. Using the product defaults is fine.

system.title: System check
system.description: Detect what this machine has and what is missing. Nothing is installed or changed.

review.title: Review
review.description: See where every project stands, then finish. Automation is switched on per project from its Readiness tab.

skipDialog.title: Skip {{step}}?
skipDialog.body: You can come back any time. Here is what skipping means.
skipDialog.none: Nothing breaks if you skip this step.
skipDialog.readiness: Skipping only changes this guide. It never makes anything ready and never changes any setting.

consequence.discovery_unavailable: Project discovery is unavailable until a GitLab connection is verified.
consequence.automation_blocked: Automation stays blocked for the projects this step prepares.
consequence.no_runs: No model runs can start without a published, bound profile.
consequence.defaults_apply: Product defaults apply: every automatic step stays manual.
consequence.issues_undetected: Problems with this machine will not be detected ahead of time.
consequence.jev_fallback_rules: Without a Jev key, routing uses the lanes' kind and difficulty.

missing.no_configured_project: No project is fully configured yet.
missing.no_ready_profile_bound: No automation-ready profile version is bound to a configured project.
missing.no_org_policy_version: The organization policy has no published version. "Use product defaults" publishes one.
missing.no_recent_preflight: No system check from the last 24 hours.

bind.title: Bind to projects
bind.needsPublished: Publish a version first, then bind it to your projects here.
bind.noProjects: There are no projects to bind yet.

review.enableHelp: Automation is enabled per project from its Readiness tab, once it has no blockers.

fix.mongo_not_replica_set: MongoDB must run as a single-node replica set. Start it with scripts/dev-mongo.sh or Docker.
fix.credential_store_unavailable: The OS credential store is unavailable. Use a build with Keychain support, or accept that secrets are lost on restart (memory store).
fix.ca_expiring: The custom CA certificate expires soon; replace it.
fix.vpn_required_maybe: The host looks like a private address that did not answer. A VPN may be required.
fix.dns_failed: The host name did not resolve. Check the URL, DNS and VPN.
fix.proxy_failed: The proxy did not answer. Check its address.
fix.binary_missing: {{name}} was not found on the PATH Orqen uses. Install it, then Re-check.
fix.binary_unreadable: {{name}} did not report a version. Check that it runs.
fix.binary_too_old: {{name}} is older than the supported version. Upgrade it, then Re-check.
fix.catherd_missing: catherd was not found. Install catherd 1.5 and make sure its folder is on the PATH.
fix.docker_missing: Docker was not found. It is only needed for commands that use Docker.
fix.launchd_not_installed: The launchd file does not exist yet. Use the commands below if you want it.
fix.launchd_not_loaded: The file exists but is not loaded. Use the commands below.
fix.dir_not_creatable: This folder cannot be created. Check permissions.
fix.dir_not_writable: This folder is not writable. Check permissions.
fix.disk_low: Less than 2 GiB is free here.
fix.catherd_version_unsupported: This catherd version is outside the supported 1.5.x window. Install a 1.5 release.
fix.claude_logged_out: claude is installed but not logged in. Run the command yourself, then Re-check.
fix.codex_logged_out: codex is installed but not logged in. Run the command yourself, then Re-check.
fix.credential_store_memory: Credentials are kept in memory and are lost when Orqen restarts. Use the keychain store for normal use.
fix.docker_not_running: Docker is installed but its engine is not running. It is only needed for commands that use Docker.
fix.ca_expired: The custom CA certificate has expired; replace it.
fix.jev_key_missing: Enter a Jev key under Models, Orchestrator & keys, or set jev.use to off in the profile.
fix.jev_key_refused: Jev refused the key. Replace it under Models, Orchestrator & keys.
fix.backend_key_missing: Enter the missing key under Models, Orchestrator & keys.
fix.unexpected_credentials_file: Orqen never writes this file. Check who created it; it holds keys in plain text.
fix.opencode_logged_out: Log in to opencode yourself; Orqen only detects the login.

system.detectOnly: This check only looks. Orqen installs nothing, changes no system setting and runs no fix for you; commands are shown for you to run yourself.
system.failedRun: The system check could not finish.
system.loadFailed: Could not load the system check.
system.empty: No system check has been run yet. Press Re-check.
system.keychainWarn: "Test write" stores and deletes one temporary item in your Keychain. macOS may ask for permission.

launchd.title: Start at login (optional)
launchd.help: Orqen can show you the launchd file and the commands that would start it at login. It never writes into ~/Library/LaunchAgents and never runs launchctl.
launchd.loadFailed: Could not load the launchd plan.

holdBody.coding_start: Coding starts only when you press Start.
holdBody.automation_paused: The organization is paused. The run continues when automation is resumed.
holdBody.project_not_enabled: Enable automation for the project, then resume.
holdBody.stale: The issue changed after coding began; it needs a new triage.
holdBody.awaiting_coding_slot: Only a limited number of runs code at the same time. This run starts when a slot is free.
holdBody.dry_run: Publishing is in dry-run. The merge request is simulated; nothing is written to GitLab.
holdBody.external_writes_paused: External writes are paused. Resume them in Settings, Publishing.

eligibility.left_filter: No longer matches the intake filter
eligibility.left_filterBody: The issue left the intake filter. The run is held; cancel it explicitly if it should stop.

run.staleBody: The issue changed after coding began, so the work may no longer match it.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this run?
cancelDialog.body: The run stops, its open question is closed and its workspace is cleaned up if it has no changes.

cancellation.requested: Cancellation requested; waiting for the running step to stop.

run.waitingNetworkBody: A provider could not be reached. Orqen retries with a growing delay; Resume tries again now.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Jira issues Orqen found, and the run working on each.
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Enable a project with a Jira mapping, or use Poll now on the project's Intake tab.

taskDetail.noSnapshot: The issue has not been read yet.
taskDetail.planArchitect: A fuller plan from the architect arrives with coding.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Questions and approvals waiting for you.

question.missing_acceptance: This issue has no acceptance criteria. What must be true when it is done?
question.ambiguous_requirements: The requirements are unclear. Please clarify what should change.
question.contradictory_requirements: The issue contradicts itself or its parent. Please say which applies.
question.untestable_acceptance: The acceptance criteria cannot be checked automatically. Please make them testable.
question.needs_clarification: Orqen cannot decide on its own whether this is safe to run. Please add what is missing.
question.already_addressed_confirm: The work may already exist. Close this run, or continue anyway?
question.multi_repo: This issue seems to need changes in more than one repository, which is not supported yet.
question.issue_inaccessible: The issue could not be read. Check the Jira connection and permissions, then resume.
question.issue_in_two_projects: Two projects match this issue. Change a project's Jira filter so only one does, then resume.
question.mapping_incomplete: The project mapping is incomplete ({{blockers}}). Fix it, then resume.
question.no_test_command: The project has no approved test command. Approve one, then resume.
question.docker_unavailable: The approved test command needs Docker and Docker is not running. Start it, then resume.
question.protected_change: The task names protected paths ({{paths}}). Proceed without changing them, or cancel.
question.packet_oversize: The pinned rules and acceptance need {{critical_bytes}} bytes but the limit is {{cap}}. Raise the limit or cancel.
question.plan_approval: Review the plan and approve it, ask for changes, or cancel.
question.credential_expired: A credential was rejected. Replace it in Integrations, then resume.
question.provider_not_found: A repository or branch could not be found. Check the project mapping, then resume.
question.clone_host_not_allowed: The repository clone address ({{host}}) is not on this connection's host. Add the host to the connection's allowed hosts, then resume.
question.target_branch_missing: The target branch was not found in the repository. Fix the mapping, then resume.
question.primary_repo_missing: The project has no primary repository. Map one, then resume.
question.disk_low: There is not enough free disk space for a workspace. Free some space, then resume.
question.git_unavailable: git 2.30 or newer is required. Install it, then resume.
question.architect_plan_approval: The architect made a plan. Review it and approve it, or ask for changes.
question.branch_rewritten: The branch {{branch}} was rewritten on the remote. Orqen will not overwrite it.
question.catherd_land_refused: catherd refused to land the change. Check the verification and review, then try again.
question.ci_timeout: The pipeline did not finish in time. Check GitLab, then resume.
question.dispatch_cap: This run reached its limit of {{cap}} role dispatches. Allow another one, or cancel.
question.env_guard_refused: This build may only write to local addresses, so the write was refused.
question.external_write_failed: A write to GitLab failed. Check the connection and the write credential, then try again.
question.external_write_uncertain: It is not known whether a write reached GitLab. Orqen looked and could not tell. Check GitLab, then resume.
question.fix_rounds_exhausted: The change did not pass after {{rounds}} rounds. Allow another round, accept it anyway, or cancel.
question.lane_owns_protected: The plan gives a lane a protected path. Change the plan or cancel.
question.plan_invalid: The architect plan is not valid ({{plan_error}}). Try again or cancel.
question.protected_paths_changed: The coder changed protected paths. Send it back, accept, or cancel.
question.publish_approval: Operations are waiting for your approval on the task.
question.review_unparseable: The reviewer {{name}} gave an answer Orqen could not read. Review again or cancel.
question.reviewer_not_independent: The review would not be independent of the coder. Change the model profile.
question.role_dispatch_uncertain: It is not known whether a role started. Try again or cancel.
question.test_weakening_suspected: The change may weaken the tests. Send it back, accept it, or cancel.
question.verification_incomplete: Some checks could not run. Fix the cause and try again, or cancel.
question.verifier_blocked: The verifier did not pass the change.
question.write_credential_expired: GitLab rejected the write credential. Replace it in Settings, Publishing, then resume.

effect.add_acceptance: Your text becomes the acceptance criteria of this run only.
effect.add_clarification: Your text is added to this run only; it never becomes a rule.
effect.cancel_run: The run ends and its workspace is cleaned up.
effect.close_run: The run ends as already addressed.
effect.continue_anyway: The run goes on to planning.
effect.proceed_without_protected: The run records that protected paths must not change.
effect.raise_context_limit: The context limit follows the current policy for this run.
effect.approve_plan: The run moves to the start gate.
effect.request_plan_changes: Your text is added and the plan is made again.
effect.resume: The run continues from where it stopped.
effect.accept_weakening: The change is accepted as it is and verified once more.
effect.adopt_remote: The remote branch becomes the run's head and is verified.
effect.hold_dry_run: The run goes on in dry-run; nothing is written.
effect.raise_dispatch_cap: One more role may be dispatched for this run.
effect.raise_fix_cap: One more fix round is allowed.
effect.send_back: The coder gets another round with a reminder.
effect.use_approval_dialog: Use the approval dialog on the task.
effect.waive_findings: Blocking findings are accepted and the run goes on.

inbox.sheetHelp: Answer to continue the run; the same run resumes where it stopped.
inbox.resolveHelp: Fix the cause elsewhere, then resume the run, or cancel it.
inbox.approvalHint: This run needs your approval before it can go on.
inbox.staleBody: The run moved on or the issue changed, so this question is no longer current. Your text is kept below.

context.title: Context packet
context.notBuilt: The packet has not been built yet.
context.pickRole: Pick a role to see its packet manifest.
context.roleNotBuilt: No packet was built for this role in this run.
context.packetOversize: Critical context did not fit: the run stopped

workspace.title: Managed workspace
workspace.head: HEAD
workspace.none: No workspace was prepared for this run.

discardDialog.title: Discard this workspace?
discardDialog.first: A snapshot of the changes is saved first, then the worktree and branch are deleted.
discardDialog.second: This cannot be undone. Discard the workspace now?

workspace.snapshotKept: A snapshot of the changes was saved before removal.
workspace.preservedBody: This workspace has changes, so it was kept. Orqen never deletes it by itself.

intake.title: Jira intake
intake.notEnabled: Automatic polling is off. Use Poll now to fetch Jira issues manually.
intake.counts: Last poll: {{seen}} seen, {{changed}} changed, {{left}} left the filter

blocked.title: Intake is blocked
blocked.body: The Jira credential was rejected. Replace it in Integrations; polling resumes by itself.

rules.subtitle: Rules you write go into the context packet of every run in their scope. Answers to questions never become rules.
rules.criticalHelp: A critical rule is never shortened. If the critical rules and the acceptance do not fit the packet limit, the run asks you instead of cutting them.
rules.conflict: This rule was changed elsewhere. Close and reopen it.

automation.help: While paused, nothing is polled and runs hold at their next stage boundary; a running step finishes.
automation.loadFailed: Could not load the automation state.

publishing.loadFailed: Could not load the publishing settings

mode.title: Write mode
mode.dryHelp: Dry-run: nothing is written to GitLab. The merge request and its exact payload are simulated and recorded.
mode.liveHelp: Live: approved operations on allowlisted projects are written to GitLab.

liveDialog.title: Enable live writes
liveDialog.description: This lets Orqen push branches and create merge requests on GitLab, one approved operation at a time.
liveDialog.pointCredential: A separate write credential that you enter is required.
liveDialog.pointApproval: Every operation shows its exact payload and waits for your approval.

allowlist.title: Write allowlist
allowlist.help: Only these projects can ever be written to.

pause.title: Pause all external writes
pause.help: A kill switch: while paused, nothing is written even if approved.

guard.title: Environment guard
guard.help: Development and test builds can only write to local addresses.
guard.loopbackOnly: This build can only write to loopback addresses.

writeCredential.title: Write credentials
writeCredential.help: A separate token used only to publish. Orqen never creates it, and workers never receive it.
writeCredential.secretHint: Stored in the Keychain; never shown again.

host.title: Orchestrator host
host.subtitle: Runs coding roles on the selected host: Codex {{version}} or newer, or Claude Code 2.1.282 or newer.
host.notProbed: The host has not been probed.
host.spikeHelp: Run the spike yourself (docs/LIVE-TRIAL.md), then attest it. Orqen never runs it.
host.spikeCodex: Host version used (Codex or Claude Code)

reasons.test_weakening_suspected: The change may weaken the tests.
reasons.no_commands: There are no commands to run.

reasons.verifier_fail: The verifier did not pass the change.
